title: Cancellable, bounded P2P preparation
notes: P2P preparation can now be cancelled immediately with Back or the visible Cancel button. No-peer results stop automatically after 40 seconds with a useful error instead of trapping the interface. Both Movies and Add-ons retain their source lists so another result can be selected. The in-place upgrade preserves each device's add-ons, Recently Watched list, favourites, progress and settings.
